navigation.notes: Five tabs, labels always visible, order mirrors in RTL, identical for every role (ADR 0008 D1); content is role-aware and navigation is not. The Bookings tab opens on Pending (HL-BOOK-01) when the pending count is above zero, otherwise on Upcoming (HL-BOOK-02), and carries the count badge (capped 9+, danger-tinted with text when any request is in the danger SLA state). The Messages tab root lives in the Today flow (HL-TODY-04) because the inbox, the thread and the notification centre are one communication surface; the More root lives in the Settings flow (HL-SETT-01). The tab bar stays visible on every pushed screen so the pending badge is always one tap away; it is hidden only on the access screens (HL-ACCS-*), while the chat composer is open (HL-TODY-05), and in the two-step offer stepper (HL-GROW-02, HL-GROW-03, now the voucher price window). Sticky save bars sit above the tab bar. Sheets documented as part of a host screen rather than as their own ID because they are small variants of it: first-run notification and biometric prompts (HL-TODY-01), booking search and date-filter sheet (HL-BOOK-02), attach and voice-note recorder (HL-TODY-05), media upload sheet (HL-VENU-01), voucher price window actions sheet (HL-GROW-01), review reply and report sheets (HL-GROW-06), language sheet, venue switcher sheet and log-out dialog (HL-SETT-01), staff invite and edit sheets (HL-SETT-03), mark-completed confirmation (HL-BOOK-03). Role-limited Today variants for Reception, Accountant and Marketing are states of HL-TODY-01. Deliberately not designed in this pass: swipe actions of any kind, venue-initiated bulk cancellation after an authority order (P2), a revenue screen of any kind (superseded), quick-reply management (defaults only), notification of marketing offers (the venue app sends transactional alerts only), tier-level price editing and menus (web only), permission-matrix editing (web only). Prototype P0 spine (ADR 0008 as amended by ADR 0033): HL-ACCS-01, HL-TODY-01, HL-BOOK-01, HL-BOOK-03, HL-BOOK-06, HL-BOOK-07, HL-DCSN-01, HL-DCSN-02, HL-DCSN-03, HL-BOOK-04, HL-CALN-01, HL-CALN-04, HL-VIST-01..03, HL-PROV-01..06, HL-TODY-04, HL-TODY-05.
navigation.voucherModel: The Partner app (the former hotel app) serves two account types (ADR 0033 D7): Hotel or wedding hall (the tabs above) and Service provider. A service provider has the same five tabs, but the Calendar tab slot is "Listings" (rootScreen HL-PROV-02), Today shows listing and request tiles, and Bookings holds requests at the voucher price. Everyone gets Redeem voucher (HL-BOOK-06) from Today and Bookings, Visits (hotels and halls) from More, and Billing and fees in More (HL-SETT-04). Major hotels (fee_exempt, set by Ghazal) see no plan or payment steps but are still reviewed.

parkedRequirements.reason: Superseded by ADR 0033: no revenue exists in the app. Today shows requests, vouchers redeemed and open dates.
Superseded by ADR 0033: no bank information for partners; replaced by Billing and fees (HA-SET-06).
Superseded by ADR 0033: venue coupon codes are removed; the voucher price is the only reduction.

globalRules: No guest mode and no self sign-up: staff are invited and sign in with +965 phone plus password; a new device needs a WhatsApp code and venue admins add an authenticator code (HA-AUTH-01, ADR 0028). High-risk actions (bank information, invite or remove staff) require a fresh WhatsApp code or password.

Role gating hides, never locks: Admin (owner, includes Manager) all; Manager all except staff and bank information; Reception accepts, declines and proposes dates, blocks and opens dates, records cash, reads and writes messages; Accountant reads bookings, records cash, sees revenue and bank information masked, reads messages; Marketing manages offers, media and sees analytics. Cancelling or rescheduling a confirmed booking is Admin and Manager only. A deep link to a forbidden object shows 'You do not have access. Ask your manager.' (HL-ACCS-04). Voucher model: Admin and Manager redeem vouchers, handle visits, manage listings and see Billing and fees; Reception redeems vouchers, replies to requests and visits; Accountant sees Billing and receipts read-only; Marketing manages voucher prices, listings and analytics. Bank information and revenue permissions no longer exist.

Booking requests never claim the calendar and never move money. Only approval (a 24 hour hold) and the client's confirmation change the calendar; the client confirms within 24 hours or the approval lapses and the hold is released. No money for an event moves through Ghazal at any point: the client pays the venue directly after confirming and the partner marks the client's Ghazal voucher redeemed by scanning its code or QR (ADR 0033).

SLA rule shared by the bar, the badge and escalation: neutral below 50% elapsed, gold from 50%, danger from 80% elapsed or under 1 hour left, always with text such as '2h 10m left'. The 'Urgent' tag is separate and means the event is 14 days away or less. Default response window 24h (12/24/48h, forced 4h within 14 days); pay window after approval 24h (12/24/48/72h, forced 6h within 14 days); counter-offer validity 48h; venue-proposed reschedule 72h.

Accept is 2 taps from a push or Needs-you row with an 8-second Undo toast; the client is notified only after the 8 seconds; a confirm sheet (3 taps) appears only for competing requests, events within 14 days or a non-default pay window. Decline is 3 taps with a required reason. Undo applies to Accept only. No swipe actions anywhere; every action is a visible control or a long-press menu.

Offline: the shell and last-known data are cached with a stamp ('Offline - updated 4:00 PM'). Accept, Decline, Propose, Block, Open and Cancel are never queued: they are disabled in place with a reason ('Offline. Reconnect to accept.'). Chat messages and media uploads may queue.

Payout gate removed (ADR 0033): there are no payouts, KYC or bank information. Accept is never blocked by payment setup. The only partner payments are listing or advertising plans (service providers and non-exempt partners), paid through the gateway; major hotels are exempt from fees but every listing is reviewed manually before it goes live.

Statuses (ADR 0033, replacing ADR 0003): Pending, Awaiting client (approved, 24 h to confirm), Confirmed, Voucher redeemed, Declined, Expired (Missed or Lapsed), Cancelled, Completed. AR chips: «بانتظار الرد» «بانتظار تأكيد العميل» «مؤكد» «تم استخدام الكوبون» «تم الاعتذار» «انتهت المهلة» «ملغي» «مكتمل». The PRD six map as in docs/architecture/booking-state-machine.md section 3.

Money: integer fils; browse format (whole dinars when fils are zero, else three decimals) on Today tiles, offers and lists; exact three decimals on Booking detail, payments, ledgers and sheets that move money; one precision per list. A price always states its unit. Currency token sits visually left of the number in both languages (KD in English, د.ك in Arabic); KWD appears only on invoices, bank and payout settings. 'You receive' amounts appear only when a commission rule exists and never to Reception. No VAT lines. Deposit 30% rounded up to the next KD 5; balance due 14 days before; Standard cancellation policy. Voucher model: partners see the voucher price and the standard price side by side on request cards; there are no revenue, payable, commission or payout figures anywhere.

Dates and time: Gregorian, weekday plus date always, never numeric-only dates and never 'ليلة' plus a weekday; 12-hour Kuwait time ('9:00 PM' / '9:00 م'); relative words only Today and Tomorrow; weeks start on Sunday with the Thu-Sat peak band at the inline-end edge; Hijri only as a muted line in Arabic summaries (6 شعبان 1448 هـ) and as approximate occasion markers. Operational countdowns in compact form ('3h left' / 'باقي 3 س') are allowed in this app only. Fixed NOW is Thu 12 Nov 2026, 4:00 PM, Asia/Kuwait.

Numerals and identifiers: Western digits in both languages through the shared formatter only (never hand-typed prices); phone numbers, booking references (GZ-2611-0147), coupon codes, IBAN and invoice numbers are LTR isolates. Fixture phones use +965 5000 00NN, are display-only and never tappable. Eastern digits only through the Settings switch.

RTL: logical properties only; back chevrons, progress, sliders, steppers, calendar grids and tab order mirror; clocks, check, plus, play triangle and phone handset never mirror; time axes in charts run in reading direction (right to left in Arabic), value axes never flip, every chart has a table twin and labels its first and last date.

Copy: Arabic is clear modern Arabic with possessive كم and verbal-noun CTAs (قبول، اعتذار، اقتراح موعد آخر، إغلاق، فتح، إرسال), gender-neutral, passive for system messages, Khaleeji only in staff-typed chat; English is British, calm and precise; no exclamation marks, no emoji, no urgency words, no 'Welcome back'. Banned: مدعو / مدعوات, حريمي, اختر / اختاري, بالرفاء والبنين, حيّاك الله, dialect words in labels, religious phrases in payment, error or discount text.

Imagery and avatars: empty rooms and details only, no identifiable faces, no alcohol, no royal or state emblems; avatars are one-letter monograms in the letter's own script; media uploads require a zone tag and warn when a face is detected.

Motion: 120/200/320/480 ms tokens, 640 ms only for the one success moment per flow; Undo toast bar depletes over 8 seconds; the thread draws on over 320 ms; money and counts never roll or count up; reduced motion removes spatial transitions and keeps all information.
Venue-authored text is bilingual: both languages are required before a venue publishes and the app shows per-language completeness; nothing is machine-translated silently.

Fixture caveats for the fixtures owner: (1) Resolved 2026-10-12: Majlis Hall capacity is 450 in every file, so Abdullah Al-Hajri's 450-guest men's section fits. (2) Fixture times: Danah Ballroom Evening 9:00 PM - 2:00 AM, Majlis Hall Evening 8:30 PM - 1:00 AM, so Today's 9:00 PM and 8:30 PM events are the session starts. (3) Reem Al-Dosari's request carries reference GZ-2611-0147 in both apps (decided 2026-10-12); Reem is the only pending request for Thu 14 Jan, so there is no competing-request row in the base seed; the block-dates demo uses Thu 24 Dec - Sat 26 Dec, not the flash-sale soft dates. (4) Pending-request order by nearest deadline is Dana, Abdullah, Maryam, Faisal, Reem, which differs from the research list order. (5) Placeholder commission 8% and gateway fee figures are not owner-approved (OQ-B-16, OQ-B-18). (6) Persona Hind Al-Enezi is a Manager, but Staff (HL-SETT-03) and Bank information (HL-SETT-04) are Admin-only: the prototype adds a role switcher (Admin: Khalid Al-Otaibi) and the Manager sees 'Ask your owner to finish payout setup' on the payout banner instead of a link.

Visits (ADR 0033 D9): hotels and halls receive free visit requests; each visit opens a three-role group chat (client, hotel representative, Ghazal support); Admin and Manager can read every visit chat of the venue, other staff only the visits they are assigned to; the chat is read-only 24 hours after the slot.

Listings (ADR 0033 D8): listings are never published automatically on payment; each needs manual moderator approval (the review queue lives in the web Super Admin). Rejections carry reason codes; the paid plan is kept for 14 days for a resubmission. Plan rates are admin-configured and undecided: show "Rates announced soon", never a number.
notes: Business model: the voucher marketplace (ADR 0033, docs/product/voucher-model.md). Per-flow impact: docs/product/voucher-model-changes.json.
Deprecated screens (kept, never renumbered): HL-BOOK-05 (invoice), HL-DCSN-05 (record cash), HL-GROW-05 (revenue).
Repurposed screens keep their ids: HL-GROW-01..03 are the voucher price windows (formerly offers); HL-SETT-04 is Billing and fees (formerly bank information).
Listing advertising plan rates are not decided: screens say "Rates announced soon" and show no number.
